property_summary: For any caller address A, calling owned() always either (a) reverts for non-owner callers under the correct contract (because onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner) OR (b) succeeds only when msg.sender == owner; the mutant removes the check so there exists some caller address for which owned() succeeds while it shouldn't, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Replace require in onlyOwner with a no-op (removed check), allowing anyone to call owned() and thus potentially change owner via owned if owned mutates state.
